name: J M Industries
old_description: JMI have been servicing the machines we sell for over 40 years. We refurbish the machines and test them to ensure they are fully operational prior to shipment. If you buy a machine from JMI, odds are good we can still service it many years later, even if the OEM won’t. We do not typically charge for evaluation.
about:
J M Industries, based in North Billerica, Massachusetts, has been servicing semiconductor manufacturing equipment since its founding in 1982. The company began as a service and refurbishment operation for the machines it sells, and over four decades has built a reputation for keeping equipment operational long after original manufacturers discontinue support.

The company refurbishes and resells a broad range of semiconductor manufacturing equipment, including thermal shock chambers, mask aligners, wire bonders, ball bonders, probers, and reflow systems. It also specializes in rebuilding vacuum pumps, blowers, and dry pumps, offering a 2‑3 week turnaround on rebuilds. J M Industries maintains one of the largest and most diversified inventories of refurbished semiconductor equipment worldwide, with over 300 dual‑stage direct‑drive pumps in stock. Technicians perform upgrades such as touch‑screen retrofits for Mech‑el and MEI wire bonders and complete SST electronics rebuilds with a one‑year warranty.

Customers include semiconductor fabs and assembly houses that need cost‑effective alternatives to new equipment purchases. The company supports equipment from brands such as Blue M, Technics, Perkin Elmer, Mechel, Karl Suss, Laurier, Ewald, Thermo/Neslab, YES, EG, Loomis, Mech‑el, and MEI. Its vacuum pump rebuilding service serves any operation relying on vacuum technology, while its equipment upgrades extend the life of legacy wire bonders and aligners.

J M Industries differentiates itself by offering long‑term support even after OEMs stop providing parts or service, and by not charging for equipment evaluations. The company contrasts its model with auctioneers and brokers, emphasizing that its refurbished machines come with a substantive warranty rather than a 'taillight' guarantee, and that it avoids buyer premiums and forced carrier choices.
